## [PLS-2] Benefits - Free Express delivery where Express is available. - No reverse pickup fee on any return. - Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check. ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.

Returns policy
Scope
## [RET-1] Scope This policy covers items bought on ZentroMart, whether shipped by ZentroMart or by a marketplace seller. Seller-specific warranty terms are in the Marketplace sellers policy, but return windows are the same for every seller.

ZentroMart Assured
## [WAR-2] ZentroMart Assured Products marked `assured = true` in the catalog carry a 12-month ZentroMart Assured warranty from the delivery date, in addition to any brand warranty. Claims are raised in the app under My Orders, and ZentroMart arranges pickup and repair or replacement.
